compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

`rebar link <source> <target> supersedes` refuses when `<source>` is closed, but the
disposition-close path that CONSUMES `supersedes` links accepts a closed source. A story
whose scope was absorbed by sibling slices can therefore never close with
`--class superseded` without an operator force, because the slices that replaced it close
before it does. Story `a256-1ae4-cf3d-4711` hit exactly this on 2026-10-30 and was
force-closed; that force is the audit signal that this gate path is unreachable.

## Observation (measured on origin/main 38f8587f65d)

- `src/rebar/graph/_links.py:260-264` (`add_dependency`) raises
  `cannot create <relation> link — source ticket '<id>' is closed` for every relation in
  `CANONICAL_RELATIONS` (`_links.py:21-35`). The next guard (`:266-271`) is already
  narrowed to `depends_on` for its closed-target check.
- `src/rebar/_commands/close_precheck.py:33-50` `_is_live_ticket` accepts any ticket that
  resolves and is not archived/deleted, so a `closed` replacement passes.
- `src/rebar/_commands/close_disposition.py:29-76` `replacement_of` reads an inbound
  `supersedes` link and filters its source through `_is_live_ticket`;
  `REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES` (`:21`) excludes `superseded`, so the link is the only evidence
  for that class. `gates.py:111-145` (`_disposition_close_exempt`) and `:184-198` turn that
  verdict into the plan-review close gate's `disposition` verdict.
- Scratch reproduction in a fresh store (epic E; open story S; closed sibling task T):
  `_is_live_ticket(T)` is `True`, and `rebar.link(T, S, rel)` raises the closed-source error
  for `supersedes`, `blocks`, `depends_on`, `duplicates`, `relates_to`, `discovered_from`.
- History: the guard arrived verbatim in the DSO extraction commit `b534f47a7f9`
  (2026-06-08) with no ticket or rationale. The reader's "live = not archived/deleted" rule
  is deliberate: commits `87a86d19b0b` (eaa9), `adc0b64a2be` (738a), `9844f6de353` (fc20)
  and `952ad4a0a61` (111a) built it, and `docs/ticket-model.md:137` documents `superseded`
  as needing "a live replacement" with a `replacement -supersedes-> ticket` link. Nothing
  in history makes the closed-source refusal deliberate for `supersedes`.
- The reconciler's closed-source classifier (`src/rebar/reconciler/impossible_links.py`)
  is unaffected: `supersedes` has no Jira link type
  (`src/rebar/reconciler/adapters/jira_family/value_maps.py:63`), so no inbound sync ever
  writes one.

## Approach

Narrow the closed-source guard by relation, the way the closed-target guard already is.
Add `_CLOSED_SOURCE_RELATIONS_ALLOWED = frozenset({"supersedes"})` in `_links.py` and skip
the refusal for those relations. `supersedes` is the one relation whose subject is the
TARGET and whose consumer (`replacement_of`) reads the source as completed replacement
work, so a closed source is its normal shape. Every other relation keeps today's refusal,
which keeps this change scoped to the observed defect. To stay under the complexity
ratchet, move both endpoint-status guards out of `add_dependency` into one helper
`_refuse_closed_endpoints(source_id, target_id, relation, tracker_dir)` with unchanged
messages, so the reconciler's `("cannot create", "is closed")` signature still matches.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/graph/_links.py` — the allowed-relations set and the extracted status guard.
- `tests/unit/test_supersedes_closed_source.py` — new failing-first tests for AC1-AC4.
- `docs/ticket-model.md` — one sentence in the administrative-dispositions section stating
  that a closed replacement may record `supersedes`, and that other relations still refuse
  a closed source.

## Testing

All tests go in `tests/unit/test_supersedes_closed_source.py` and are written before the
fix, run red, then green. Happy paths: the closed-source `supersedes` link is written on the
library and CLI surfaces; the superseded story then closes through the armed gates.
Failure paths: `blocks` and `depends_on` from a closed source still raise the unchanged
message; a `superseded` close with no link is still refused. Existing suites that cover this
code stay green: `tests/unit/reconciler/apply/test_impossible_links_cicada.py`,
`tests/unit/test_administrative_close_dispositions.py`,
`tests/unit/test_close_gate_disposition_69b9.py`, and `tests/scripts/graph/`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC1: In a store with epic E, open story S and a closed sibling task T,
      `rebar.link(T, S, "supersedes")` and `link_cli([T, S, "supersedes"])` both succeed,
      and T's reduced `deps` holds `{"relation": "supersedes", "target_id": S}`; verified by
      `pytest tests/unit/test_supersedes_closed_source.py -k writes`.
- [ ] AC2: The guard is narrowed, not removed: `blocks` and `depends_on` from closed T still
      raise `cannot create <relation> link — source ticket '<T>' is closed`, one test per
      relation; verified by `pytest tests/unit/test_supersedes_closed_source.py -k refuses`
      and by `tests/unit/reconciler/apply/test_impossible_links_cicada.py` passing unchanged.
- [ ] AC3: With that link present and both `require_plan_review_for_close` and
      `require_completion_verification_for_close` armed, `transition S open closed
      --class=superseded` (no `--force`) exits 0, `close_plan_review_gate_check` returns
      verdict `disposition`, the billable verifier is never called, and the signed
      `completion-verifier` manifest starts `completion-verifier: DISPOSITION superseded`
      and contains `replacement: <T>`; verified by
      `pytest tests/unit/test_supersedes_closed_source.py -k closes`.
- [ ] AC4: Writer and reader agree: for sources in each reachable status (`open`,
      `in_progress`, `closed`), whenever `_is_live_ticket(source)` is `True` the writer
      creates the `supersedes` link and `replacement_of(S, require_live=True)` returns that
      source; verified by `pytest tests/unit/test_supersedes_closed_source.py -k agree`.
- [ ] AC5: `make lint` and `make typecheck` pass locally (complexity and mechanism ratchets
      included, no baseline edits), the affected test directories pass locally, and the
      Gerrit change carries `Verified +1` (CI runs the `make verify` test selection) and
      `LLM-Review +1` before it merges; verified by the Gerrit change's labels, recorded in
      a ticket comment.
- [ ] AC6: The administrative-dispositions section of `docs/ticket-model.md` states that a
      closed replacement may record a `supersedes` link while other relations still refuse
      a closed source; verified by `grep -nE 'closed replacement.*supersedes'
      docs/ticket-model.md` returning a line inside that section.
